localChanges: A game loaded from a save now shows, along the top of the page, which turn has started and which civilization is moving while you wait for your turn, as a new game does (closes #588).
Those lines now read "Turn 42" and "The Babylonians are moving…" rather than "turn start 42" and "player turn-start: Babylonian", and a civilization you haven't met yet is no longer named in them.
